description: Is the exchange in its core session at this instant? (NYSE holidays and 13:00 early closes, or a caller calendar) — For up to 50 caller-supplied instants, reports whether the NYSE core session (09:30-16:00 America/New_York, 13:00 on early-close days) is open, the reason when closed (weekend, named holiday, before open, after close), that day's open and close instants and the next open; or the same for a caller venue (zone, open, close, holidays, early closes). NYSE data is a dated snapshot of nyse.com covering

close.description: venue caller only, local HH:MM, after open.

expect.description: If given, status is fail for any instant whose state differs.

holidays.description: Extra non-business dates YYYY-MM-DD (company closures, a calendar we do not carry).

instants.description: RFC 3339 timestamps with Z or offset.

weekend.description: Non-business weekdays, 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Default [0, 6]; use [5, 6] for a Friday/Saturday weekend.

name: market-session
